# Hammer & Mold

> An auction house for original vintage toys. Sellers upload photos; our AI identifies, dates, grades and validates each toy; buyers bid. Kenner Star Wars, The Real Ghostbusters, Japanese kaiju and more. Shipping included, tracked, across the EU.

Hammer & Mold is a curated, auction-first marketplace for genuine vintage collectible toys, based in the Netherlands. Every lot is identified, condition-graded and told: the toy, the maker, and the story behind it. Only genuine collectibles are accepted; prohibited or non-toy items are rejected automatically.

## How it works
- Sellers upload a few clear photos, including a close-up of the maker's stamp (molded year, country and factory markings).
- Identification is free and unlimited: anyone can photograph a toy and be told what it is, who made it, what year, what it originally shipped with and what condition it is in. A listing token is spent only when the seller decides to list it.
- AI curation writes the listing, dates the year and line, grades condition and flags variants.
- Pricing is then researched, not guessed: a second step searches public listings for recent sales of the same toy and prices the lot from those comparables, showing the seller each comparable with its source link, whether it sold or is only being asked, and how close a match it is. Sold prices outweigh asking prices. When nothing comparable is found we say so rather than inventing a number.
- Lots run as live auctions with bidding, hidden reserves, anti-snipe extension and Buy-now. Buyers pay securely. Shipping is included in the price shown, tracked, to the Netherlands and the EU. Buyers can review sellers after a purchase.

## The Molders (makers)
- Kenner (Cincinnati) - Star Wars 1977-1985, The Real Ghostbusters 1986-1991
- Marusan, Bullmark and Popy (Tokyo) - soft-vinyl kaiju 1966-1984, the Godzilla and Ultraman monsters of the tokusatsu boom
- Playmates - Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1988-1997
- LJN - E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial 1982
- Galoob - The A-Team 1983-1984
- Thinkway Toys - Toy Story 1995
- Each maker has its own documentary page; each toy links back to its Molder.

## Seller packages
- Three packages. Starter is free with the standard commission; Trader and Dealer are paid monthly memberships with a larger listing allowance and a lower commission. Dealer includes featured placement.
- The current price, listing allowance and commission of each package are published on the packages page and in the seller's account, and are the authoritative figures. They are not restated here so they cannot go stale.
- The packages are priced so that the one matching a seller's volume is always the cheapest of the three: at the point a seller's listing allowance runs out, moving up does not cost more than staying put.
- A chooser on the packages page takes the seller's own monthly sales and average price and names the package that costs them least, including telling them to stay on the free one when that is the answer.
- Moving up takes effect immediately and is prorated. Moving down takes effect at the end of the period already paid for, and can be cancelled until then. Unused tokens roll over up to twice the monthly allowance and are never removed by moving down.
- Identification is free and unlimited on every package. One token = one listing. Extra token packs can be bought at any time.
- Featured placement is advertising and is always labelled as a paid promotion. It changes only where a lot appears, never the bidding, the commission or the outcome. Outside the promoted strip, payment does not influence ranking.
- Sellers are paid from a balance on the same date every month whenever it stands at EUR 25 or more. A smaller balance rolls over and is paid out regardless of size at least once every three months, so nothing sits with the platform indefinitely. The minimum exists because each payout carries a fixed provider cost; balances can be released on request at any time.
- Commission is charged on the total the buyer pays, postage included, because the total is what the platform processes. Postage is passed to the carrier at the price quoted.

## Shipping
- Postage is quoted live from the carrier, not set by the seller. At checkout the buyer gives a delivery address and the parcel is priced for that country from the lot's packed weight.
- The buyer chooses the service: through the letterbox where the item fits, collection from a pickup point, or delivery to the door. Domestic rates currently run from EUR 3.85 to EUR 7.13.
- The checkout total is the total; postage is never added afterwards or invoiced separately, and a seller cannot change it.
- Tracked, to the Netherlands and the EU. Buyers elsewhere should ask before bidding.
- Risk in transit stays with the platform until the buyer takes physical possession, as EU consumer law requires, and that holds whether or not a carrier pays anything out. The site does not describe parcels as "insured": a promise that depends on an insurer deciding per claim whether a vintage toy counts as an antique is not a promise, so the platform carries the risk itself instead.
- Commission is charged on the total the buyer pays, postage included, because the total is what the platform processes. Postage is passed to the carrier at the price quoted.

## Launch
- The public auctions open on 1 October 2026. Before then, lots appear in Preview and early sign-ups are welcome.
